# .github folder

This folder contains files and information specific to the GitHub repository.

You may be interested in this folder if you are modifying how the repository is displayed on GitHub for example the issue and Pull Request templates or if you want to fix or change the GitHub Actions.

## Why is this folder called about instead of readme?

The `readme.md` file is the default file for the repository, but it is not the only file that GitHub will display on the repository homepage. GitHub would display the `./.github/readme.md` instead of `./readme.md` file if it exists.
